blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear, sharp text with well-defined character edges throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as the text sharpness is excellent for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt exhibits excellent contrast with black text printed on white thermal paper creating high readability.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed as contrast is optimal for text recognition.

glare_identification.description: Slight glare appears on the upper portion of the receipt from lighting or camera flash, but does not significantly impact text readability.
glare_identification.recommendation: Adjust lighting conditions when capturing images to minimize reflections, though current glare is minimal and doesn't impair data extraction.

water_stains.description: No water stains, discoloration, or water damage is visible on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue to keep receipts dry and protected from liquid exposure.

tears_or_folds.description: The receipt appears intact with no visible tears, creases or fold marks that would affect text recognition.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Continue to handle receipts carefully to maintain their physical integrity.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the receipt are visible within the frame with no apparent cut-off sections.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Current framing is appropriate; continue to ensure full receipt capture in future scans.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with header, line items, tax information, total amount, and footer information all present.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed as all standard receipt components are visible and intact.

obstructions.description: A glass ashtray or similar transparent object is partially visible at the top left corner but only minimally overlaps the receipt without obscuring any text.
obstructions.recommendation: Remove all objects from the scanning area when capturing receipt images, though current obstruction does not impact data extraction.
